description: This file contains styling rules for the Online Tic Tac Toe game's frontend, providing aesthetic and layout configurations for various components of the app.

classes.name: game-container
classes.description: Styles the main container for the game with padding and margin.

classes.name: score-panel
classes.description: Styles the panel displaying the score, with background color, border radius, and shadow.

classes.name: game-mode
classes.description: Flex display settings for the game mode selection buttons.

classes.name: game-board
classes.description: Grid layout styles for arranging the game cells.

classes.name: cell
classes.description: Styles for individual game cells, including border and hover effects.

classes.name: game-actions
classes.description: Flex settings for action buttons below the game board.

classes.name: btn
classes.description: Base styling for buttons across the application.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application styles, including text alignment and background settings.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Styles for the application header, defining layout and background.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Styles for the button that toggles themes.
